$description: Voice rules for every word on iitjeekota.com. Read by the copy linter (make copy-lint), the brand guide and the linter's tests. Each example's before must fail and its after must pass.

scan.$description: What make copy-lint reads, relative to the repository root. Page copy and widget data are in packages/content; the site's own UI strings are in apps/web/src/i18n.

principles: Write like a senior teacher talking to a parent at the front desk.
Short sentences. Common words. One idea per sentence.
Numbers beat adjectives: say 30 students a batch, not small batches.
Every claim has a source in the facts register, or it is cut.
Indian English spelling: programme, centre, enrol, practise (verb).
Sentence case for every heading. No labels above headings.
Hindi and Marathi are written by native writers, not translated by machine.
Explain Kota once and clearly: D-SAP Ghule Tutorials is powered by a named Kota institute, with Kota faculty. It is a partnership, never a style copied from Kota.

dashes.message: Use a full stop, comma or colon instead of a dash. For ranges write 9 to 10.

en.use: give the fact that makes it good

claims.$description: Words that make a claim. Allowed only where a line carries `copy-lint-allow: <word>` after legal review (CCPA coaching guidelines 2024), for example a blog title in question form.

warnings.$description: Not wrong, but usually a sign of padded or formal writing. Reported, never fatal.

en.message: Drop the 'not just X, but Y' frame. Say Y.
Do not open with 'Imagine'. State the fact.

examples.before: Unlock your child's potential with our world-class Kota-style coaching.
examples.after: Your child learns from Kota faculty in Pune, in a batch of 30.

examples.before: We offer a holistic journey that seamlessly blends boards and JEE.
examples.after: Board revision and JEE practice run in the same week, so neither falls behind.

examples.before: Not just coaching, but a complete transformation.
examples.after: Daily practice, a weekly test and a report every Sunday.

examples.before: Batches for Class 9 – 10 start soon — enrol now!
examples.after: Batches for Class 9 and 10 start on 1 April. Enrolment is open.

examples.before: The best IIT JEE coaching in Pune, guaranteed results.
examples.after: IIT JEE coaching in Pune, powered by Kota. Results with course and year are on the results page.
